title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-08-28
source: AUD UNKNOWN LINEAGE > REEL > EDIROL USB UA-1EX AUDIO INTERFACE > COOL EDIT > CD WAVE EDITOR > TRADERS LITTLE HELPER > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience tape that captures a psychedelic second set with the classic Pig riff and a standout Good Morning Little Schoolgirl.
ai_review.review: The three reviews agree this is one of the better 1968 audience recordings on the Archive – lo‑fi but clearer than most AUDs from that era.  The show itself is praised for its high‑energy, psychedelic “hits,” especially the second‑set Pig riff and a rare Good Morning Little Schoolgirl performance, even though the first set is missing.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4 stars and highlighted both solid musical moments and a decent recording for its era; consistency across reviews yields high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical 1968 audience tape – not pristine, but clearer and more balanced than most AUDs from the period; no major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is missing from the reels; the available material focuses on a high‑energy second set and encore, delivering a solid psychedelic flow.
